limits: Entry XP/level is an explicit current progression-plan fixture, not earned campaign XP or playing chapters1–13.
Native production App/Engine. DOM/render/storage and clock are doubles; not browser/UI or human-time evidence.
Legal rank1/stat6/four-slot entry; actual MP and move budgets. No live actor, resource, objective or phase injection; no consumables.
Failures, misses and navigation replans remain in the trace. Completion alone is not tactical-quality approval.
Rank1 build leaves 15–18 skill points unused per hero; lawful, not an average or optimal build.
Explicit pre-battle current-plan fixture replaces an obsolete historical XP-ledger assertion. No live edits.
